app.title: Digital credential verification
app.description: Digital credential verification: view, share and check credentials using the Open Badges standard.

verifyPage.ob3Desc: Open Badges 3.0 is an open standard for digital credentials that is not tied to any specific platform or organization.
verifyPage.instantDesc: Get immediate verification results with detailed certificate information
verifyPage.formatsDesc: Support for various certificate formats including Open Badges and Verifiable Credentials

faq.a1: Our verification system checks the certificate's digital signature and metadata according to the Open Badges 3.0 standard. This ensures the certificate is authentic, untampered, and issued by a legitimate authority.
faq.q2: What types of certificates can I verify?
faq.a2: You can verify any digital certificate issued through {brand}, including Open Badges 3.0 and other compatible verifiable credentials.
faq.a3: Yes. We use the Open Badges 3.0 standard, which makes each credential tamper-evident and verifiable. All data is processed securely and transparently.
faq.a4: Verification is instant in most cases: the system checks authenticity and validity with the Open Badges 3.0 protocol and returns results within seconds.
faq.q5: What information is shown in the verification results?
faq.a5: Results include the certificate's status, issuer details, issue date, expiration date (if any) and the Open Badges 3.0 verification proof. You can also view the full certificate details if available.

saberes.title: Recognition of prior learning
saberes.intro: If you learned something at work, on your own or elsewhere, you can ask for it to be recognized with a {brand} credential.
saberes.step1: Choose the credential and read what you need to demonstrate.
saberes.step2: Explain what you can do and how you can show it.
saberes.step3: The unit you choose reviews your request within ten working days.
saberes.step4: If your learning is recognized, the credential appears in your portal.
saberes.loginTitle: Sign in to submit or check requests
saberes.loginText: We use your account's email to identify you and follow up on your requests. If you already signed in to the portal, you may only need to confirm access to this section.

saberes.verifyText: Open your institutional account settings and follow the steps to verify it. Check your spam folder too. Then sign in here again; copy any text you want to keep first.

saberes.evidenciasHelp: You can include links or references; files can't be attached here. Don't include passwords or ID documents.
saberes.check: Before submitting, check that the credential and the unit are right and that your examples explain what you can do.
saberes.deadline: You'll get an answer within ten working days, counted from the day after you submit. No emails are sent: check progress on this page.

saberes.reopenHelp: There is one reopening per request and it counts even if declined. If accepted, the ten-working-day period starts again.
